name: showcase-resilient-pipeline
description: A team that survives a dead provider. Every worker's chain STARTS with `codex:gpt-5.6-codex`, which this account cannot use — the API answers 'The gpt-5.6-codex model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account'. That is a real, deterministic, repeatable rejection rather than a simulated one, and unlike burning a rate limit it costs nothing and works every time. The run should walk the chain, journal agent.candidate_failed then agent.failover, re-deliver any unanswered messages to the replacement, and finish. Note the fallback is codex:gpt-6-astra — the same CLI, a model the account DOES have — so this proves per-model failover, not just per-vendor.
